page: Microsoft Azure NC8as_T4_v3 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine belonging to the NCASv3_T4 family. It features an AMD processor with 8 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 56.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

For hardware acceleration, the server includes a single NVIDIA T4 GPU with 15 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage consists of a 360 GB SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage for expanded disk configurations.

The hardware profile offers a balanced allocation of memory and dedicated CPU resources alongside entry-level GPU acceleration. This configuration is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring GPU-assisted compute without the high overhead of larger multi-GPU nodes. Suitable workloads include machine learning inference, lightweight deep learning training, video transcoding, and graphics rendering.
